title: Average strategy's payoff against a pure column
hypotheses_covered: each per-round strategy has non-negative weights
each per-round strategy's weights sum to 1
payoff entries lie in [0,1] (from the game structure)
replaced:
For a game $G$, a column $j$, and $T$ row distributions
$p_0, \dots, p_{T-1}$,
\[
  \mathrm{payoffVsPure}(G, \bar{p}, j)
  \;=\;
  \frac{1}{T} \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} \sum_{i} p_t(i) \cdot A_{ij},
\]
where $\bar{p}$ is the average strategy.
